2608.02238.title: Trustworthy AI in Digital Health: A Comprehensive Review of Robustness and Explainability
2608.02238.paper_summary: Ensuring trust in AI systems is essential for the safe and ethical integration of machine learning systems into high-stakes domains such as digital health. Key dimensions, including robustness, explainability, fairness, accountability, and privacy, need to be addressed throughout the AI lifecycle, from problem formulation and data collection to model deployment and human interaction. While various contributions address different aspects of trustworthy AI, a focused synthesis on robustness and explainability, especially tailored to the healthcare context, remains limited. This review addresses that need by organizing recent advancements into an accessible framework, highlighting both technical and practical considerations. We present a structured overview of methods, challenges, and solutions, aiming to support researchers and practitioners in developing reliable and explainable AI solutions for digital health. This review article is organized into three main parts. First, we introduce the pillars of trustworthy AI and discuss the technical and ethical challenges, particularly in the context of digital health. Second, we explore application-specific trust considerations across domains such as intensive care, neonatal health, and metabolic health, highlighting how robustness and explainability support trust. Lastly, we present recent advancements in techniques aimed at improving robustness under data scarcity and distributional shifts, as well as explainable AI methods ranging from feature attribution to gradient-based interpretations and counterfactual explanations. This paper is further enriched with detailed discussions of the contributions toward robustness and explainability in digital health, the development of trustworthy AI systems in the era of LLMs, and various evaluation metrics for measuring trust and related parameters such as validity, fidelity, and diversity.
2608.02238.paper_summary_zh: 確保對 AI 系統的信任對於安全和倫理地將機器學習系統整合到數位健康等高風險領域至關重要。<lb/>關鍵維度，包括穩健性、可解釋性、公平性、問責性和隱私，需在 AI 生命週期的各個階段加以考量，從問題定義和數據收集到模型部署和人類互動。<lb/>儘管各種貢獻針對可信 AI 的不同方面進行了探討，但專注於穩健性和可解釋性的綜合，特別是針對醫療保健背景的綜合，仍然有限。<lb/>本次評審滿足了這一需求，通過將近期的進展組織成一個可訪問的框架，突出了技術和實際考量。<lb/>我們提供了一個結構化的概述，涵蓋方法、挑戰和解決方案，旨在支持研究人員和實踐者開發可靠且可解釋的數位健康 AI 解決方案。<lb/>這篇評審文章分為三個主要部分。<lb/>首先，我們介紹可信 AI 的支柱，並討論技術和倫理挑戰，特別是在數位健康的背景下。<lb/>其次，我們探討特定應用的信任考量，涵蓋重症監護、新生兒健康和代謝健康等領域，強調穩健性和可解釋性如何支持信任。<lb/>最後，我們介紹旨在改善數據稀缺和分佈變化下穩健性的技術的最新進展，以及從特徵歸因到基於梯度的解釋和反事實解釋的可解釋 AI 方法。<lb/>本文還詳細討論了在數位健康中對穩健性和可解釋性的貢獻、在 LLM 時代發展可信 AI 系統的情況，以及各種評估指標，用於測量信任及相關參數，如有效性、忠實性和多樣性。
